reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Jellyfin no longer accepts the saved login for **{username}** on {url}. Enter the password again.

user.title: Connect to Jellyfin
user.description: How should Jellyfin Plus log in?

password.title: Connect to Jellyfin
password.description: Use an **administrator** account to get events for every user. A normal account only sees its own playback.

api_key.title: Connect with an API key
api_key.description: Create a key in Jellyfin under **Dashboard → API Keys**. An API key may read every user's data and control every session, so no special user permissions are needed.

api_user.title: Library user
api_user.description: Which Jellyfin user's libraries, Next up and counts should Jellyfin Plus show by default? Other users can be linked to Home Assistant users later under Configure.

reauth_api_key.title: New API key
reauth_api_key.description: Jellyfin no longer accepts the API key for {url}. Enter a new one (Dashboard → API Keys).

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the Jellyfin server. Check the URL and that it's running.
error.no_users: The server returned no users for this API key.

abort.already_configured: This Jellyfin server is already set up.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Shows a message on the Jellyfin client's screen.

title.name: Title
title.description: Heading of the message (default: Home Assistant).

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds until the message disappears (0 = stays until dismissed).

pause.name: Pause playback
pause.description: Pause what's playing before showing the message.

mark_played.name: Mark as watched
mark_played.description: Marks an item as watched for a Jellyfin user.

item_id.name: Item
item_id.description: Jellyfin item id (e.g. from a playback event's item_id).

jellyfin_user.name: Jellyfin user
jellyfin_user.description: Name or id. Default: the linked Jellyfin user of whoever runs this, else the integration's account.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with several Jellyfin servers.

mark_unplayed.name: Mark as unwatched
mark_unplayed.description: Marks an item as unwatched for a Jellyfin user.

item_id.name: Item
item_id.description: Jellyfin item id (e.g. from a playback event's item_id).

jellyfin_user.name: Jellyfin user
jellyfin_user.description: Name or id. Default: the linked Jellyfin user of whoever runs this, else the integration's account.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with several Jellyfin servers.

set_favorite.name: Set favorite
set_favorite.description: Adds or removes an item from a Jellyfin user's favorites.

item_id.name: Item
item_id.description: Jellyfin item id (e.g. from a playback event's item_id).

jellyfin_user.name: Jellyfin user
jellyfin_user.description: Name or id. Default: the linked Jellyfin user of whoever runs this, else the integration's account.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with several Jellyfin servers.

favorite.name: Favorite
favorite.description: Off removes it from the favorites.

sleep_timer.name: Sleep timer
sleep_timer.description: Pauses or stops playback after some minutes or when the current movie/episode ends.

end_of_item.name: At the end of this item
end_of_item.description: Instead of minutes: act when the current movie, episode or song ends (before the next one starts).

cancel_sleep_timer.name: Cancel sleep timer
cancel_sleep_timer.description: Cancels the media player's sleep timer.

init.title: Link users
init.description: Link each Home Assistant user to their Jellyfin account. Their progress, watched state and Next up are then used when they start something or run an action, and each linked person gets their own Next up, Currently watching and calendar entities.{note}

data.add_session_user: Also save progress for the person who started playback on a shared device
data.library_user: Library user of the integration (API key login)

abort.not_loaded: Load the integration first (it must be connected to Jellyfin).
